title: PCA/Marchenko-Pastur residual mean reversion across the MT5 universe
mechanism: latent common factors (USD, JPY, risk, rates, metals beta) explain most co-movement; the residual after removing NON-NOISE eigenvalues mean-reverts because it is instrument-specific dislocation with no persistent information behind it
note: highest-value direct alpha of the batch; runs on the 197-symbol H1 universe already on disk
discipline: external prior, NOT evidence of alpha -- same 10 gates, same forward window as everything else; influencer P&L claims carry zero weight

title: OU half-life + s-score entry/exit for residual trades
mechanism: residual deviation speed-of-reversion is measurable; entries at extreme s-score with exit near equilibrium harvest the reversion while bounding holding time
discipline: external prior, NOT evidence of alpha -- same 10 gates, same forward window as everything else; influencer P&L claims carry zero weight

title: Reference-venue composite vs Fusion CFD quote convergence (BTC/ETH CFDs)

title: Independent elite-survivor synchronization (consensus within a tight window)
